added.title: Head of Platform Architecture
added.description:
Work Your Magic with us! Start your next chapter and join EMD Serono.

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Your Role

We are looking for a senior, hands-on platform architect to own the technical foundation for commercial, enterprise-grade data products and digital platforms. Together with your team, you will translate complex customer and business needs into secure, resilient and maintainable architectures, while staying close enough to implementation to remain credible with principal and staff engineers. You will define reusable capabilities that help teams move from prototype to customer-ready product without compromising product ownership or customer value.

Can sit in Burlington or Billerica

Your Responsibilities

Own the platform architecture
Define and communicate the target architecture for commercial, cloud-native data platforms and digital products across a portfolio of products and deployment models, translating ambiguous customer and business needs into technical strategy, platform capabilities and delivery roadmaps.
Establish architectural principles, standards and decision frameworks covering reuse, security, scalability and supportability.
Design data and AI platforms across heterogeneous sources, including ingestion, transformation, storage, analytics, provenance, lineage, quality, access control and secure multi-tenancy.
Design appropriate SaaS, multi-cloud, hybrid and customer-managed deployment strategies, balancing security, data residency, resilience, cost and portability.
Design APIs, integration patterns, identity and authentication services, event-driven and distributed components.
Make build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions across platforms such as Palantir Foundry, cloud services, managed SaaS and open source.

Architect for security and compliance
Apply security-by-design and defense-in-depth, including threat modeling, identity, least privilege, encryption, secure software delivery and vulnerability management.
Design platforms that are certifiable and audit-ready, partnering with security, privacy, quality, legal and audit functions on controls, evidence and customer assessments.
Translate relevant security, privacy and regulated-industry frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR and GxP, into concrete architectural controls.
Shape secure multi-party data ecosystems that preserve data ownership, provenance, permissions, isolation and control over data use.

Stay technically close to implementation
Review designs, prototypes and critical code paths to surface architectural and operational risk early.
Establish practices for infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, testing, release management, observability and production debugging.
Help teams industrialize prototypes and MVPs and resolve difficult problems across application, infrastructure, data and security boundaries, choosing technologies according to the problem rather than habit.

Lead and communicate
Provide technical direction and mentorship across levels, including senior and principal engineers, and raise the technical bar without becoming a bottleneck.
Support hiring, team design and capability development in partnership with engineering leadership.
Explain architectural decisions, limitations, costs and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product leaders, customers, partners, auditors and executives.

Who You Are

Minimum Qualifications

Platform architecture depth: significant experience designing and building sophisticated software, cloud, data or AI platforms and customer-facing digital products at enterprise scale, with the ability to translate customer problems into architectures and executable roadmaps.
Multi-tenant and deployment architecture: experience designing secure multi-tenant platforms and multi-cloud, hybrid-cloud or customer-managed deployment models.
Security and compliance: substantial hands-on experience owning secure architecture decisions in production, with working knowledge of relevant frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR and, where relevant, HIPAA or GxP/GAMP 5.

Preferred Qualifications

Building platforms that connect sensitive data, including healthcare or clinical data, across organizational, business or legal boundaries.
Palantir Foundry or comparable enterprise data platforms, including data products, ontology, governance and lineage.
Experience building commercial software products, partner ecosystems, customer-managed deployments or cyber-physical and digital-twin solutions.
Cloud-native architecture: demonstrated depth on at least one major provider, including containers, serverless, networking, IAM and observability.
Data-platform architecture: experience with ingestion, transformation, storage, analytics, lineage, access controls, tenant-aware governance and data quality.
Technical leadership: credibility to challenge senior engineers, communicate across technical and commercial audiences, and lead collaboratively as a player-coach.

Pay Range for this position: $195,800-$293,800

The offer range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base pay compensation for this position. The actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level of experience, education, skills, and other job-related factors. Position may be eligible for sales or performance-based bonuses. Benefits offered by the Company include health insurance, paid time off (PTO), retirement contributions, and other perquisites. For more information click here
.

What we offer:
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

added.description:

$250,000 - $275,000 USD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Line Of Business

Technology Solutions

Job Description

The Head of U.S. Software Engineering is a transformational technology leader responsible for driving engineering excellence, modernization, cloud and platform strategy, API engineering, AI-enabled software delivery, and large-scale technology transformation across the enterprise.

This leader oversees a multidisciplinary organization spanning Software Engineering, API Engineering, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Cloud Engineering, and Engineering Enablement, partnering closely with Technology, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Security, and Business leaders to deliver secure, resilient, scalable, and reusable technology capabilities that accelerate business outcomes

Depth & Scope

Provides people management leadership by hiring the best talent, setting goals, developing staff, managing employee performance and compensation decisions, promoting teamwork and handling any/all disciplinary actions, as required
Oversees software engineering and API development teams
Sets the strategic direction, overseeing the development of software solutions, managing the API lifecycle, and driving the adoption of best practices across the organization
Establishes and maintains a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement and drive the development of scalable, high-performance software solutions that meet customer needs and deliver business value
Oversees the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and deployment
Ensures the adoption of industry best practices in software engineering, such as agile methodologies, DevSecOps
Drives the use of modern software technologies and development frameworks, ensuring software systems are robust, secure, and scalable
Ensures that APIs are designed, developed, and maintained with best practices around security, scalability, versioning, and performance
Defines API standards, governance, and documentation to ensure consistency and reliability across the organization

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 7 years in a leadership role overseeing software and API development teams
Proven hands on experience with API architecture, design, development, and management, including RESTful services, SOAP, and GraphQL, Kafka, Java, JavaScript, Python, Node.JS, SpringBoot, Swagger, Postman, Oracle
Strong understanding of API security (OAuth, JWT)
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Knowledge of API management platforms (e.g., Apigee, API Gateway)
Expertise in modern software engineering practices, tools, and technologies (e.g., cloud computing, microservices, containerization, CI/CD, etc.)
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with agile development methodologies and tools (Scrum, Jira, etc.)
Familiarity with modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The listed or specified responsibilities & duties are considered essential functions for ADA purposes.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

TD Bank is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you are an applicant with a disability and need accommodations to complete the application process, please email TD Bank US Workplace Accommodations Program at USWAPTDO@td.com. Include your full name, best way to reach you and the accommodation needed to assist you with the applicant process.

The Role

The Director, Technical Publications and Content Engineering reports to the Senior Director, Specification and Testing and leads the Technical Publications function. This leader is responsible for the team, services, practices, platforms, and governance through which the Bluetooth SIG’s technical documents are written, edited, reviewed, maintained, and published.

The Director will provide strong, inclusive people leadership; deliver responsive, high-quality service to members and member groups; and guide the evolution of technical content toward modern content-engineering practices. The role also serves as a trusted strategic advisor to the Senior Director on priorities, capabilities, risks, and opportunities.

Roles And Responsibilities

Lead, develop, and support the Technical PublicationsContent Engineering team, including organizational planning, performance management, coaching, hiring, and succession development.
Lead the delivery of technical writing and editing services for Working Group-developed Bluetooth specifications throughout development, review, approval, and publication.
Lead the planning, writing, editing, maintenance, and publication of SIG-developed test documents, ICS materials, qualification content, implementation guidance, and related technical documentation.
Ensure responsive, high-quality service to members, Working Groups, committees, and other stakeholders, and continually improve their experience working with Technical Publications.
Lead the team’s transition toward lightweight markup, GitHub-based collaboration, docs-as-code workflows, structured and reusable content, automation, and responsible AI-enabled practices.
Define and maintain editorial standards, content architecture, templates, terminology, quality controls, and publication practices across the technical-documentation portfolio.
Establish clear operating mechanisms, measures, and reporting to support quality, consistency, traceability, compliance, capacity planning, and reliable delivery.
Oversee required editorial, technical, legal, procedural, and publication reviews, ensuring that documentation processes align with applicable policies and governance requirements.
Partner with engineering, testing, qualification, legal, IT, product, program, and member-facing teams to improve end-to-end content processes and supporting tools.
Assess emerging content technologies and recommend practical investments that improve author and editor productivity, document quality, maintainability, and member value.
Advise the Senior Director, Specification and Testing on technical-publicationscontent engineering strategy, organizational capability, priorities, risks, opportunities, and investment needs.
Represent Content EngineeringTechnical Publications with executive leadership, member groups, committees, cross-functional forums, and the Board as appropriate.
Manage the function’s budget, vendors, contractors, and external service relationships as assigned.
Support a global organization and travel worldwide up to 10 percent of the time.

Skills and Requirements

10+ years of progressive experience in technical publications, technical writing and editing, documentation, content operations, or a related field.
5+ years of people-leadership experience, including leading managers and experienced writing or editing professionals.
Demonstrated success leading technical-documentation teams through significant technology, workflow, or organizational change.
Strong technical writing and editing foundation, with experience producing complex, highly structured, and technically precise documentation.
Experience with Git and GitHub-based content collaboration, docs-as-code practices, and lightweight markup such as AsciiDoc or Markdown.
Experience applying automation and AI-assisted capabilities to authoring, editing, review, quality assurance, publishing, or content maintenance.
Experience establishing scalable documentation governance, editorial standards, review controls, and compliance processes.
Experience supporting standards development, member-driven organizations, technical consortia, open-source communities, or similarly complex stakeholder environments is strongly preferred.
Warm, effective, and inclusive leadership style with a demonstrated ability to build trust, accountability, collaboration, and professional growth.
Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and executive-communication skills.
Diplomatic communicator, influencer, and consensus-builder who can navigate differing technical and organizational perspectives.
Strategic and critical thinker with strong operational judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to translate direction into clear plans and results.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, identify and communicate risk, and deliver predictably in a global environment.
A committed steward of organization values: commitment, creativity, respect, integrity, collaboration, and humility.

Who We Are

At the Bluetooth Special Interest Group ('the SIG'), we envision a world where everything and everyone that wants to connect should be able to do so in a simple, secure, and wireless way. We advance the awareness and understanding of Bluetooth technology worldwide, oversee the development of new generations of Bluetooth technology, and provide the processes and tools for developers to build, test, qualify, and brand their Bluetooth products.

Our collaborative, fast-paced company culture and critical role in creating a more connected world with Bluetooth products will put you at the forefront of technology innovation.

At the SIG, collaboration, commitment, integrity, respect, humility, and creativity are at the core of who we are and are displayed on a daily basis. We use our values to cultivate relationships with our members, business partners, and our organization. When joining the Bluetooth SIG, you share and display these values at the highest level.

Not only do we care about getting work done and how we work together, we care about YOU – by providing learning and development opportunities, social events, a safety program, a wellbeing program, free snacks and drinks, and cool company swag.
